content: Hello, I am Lattice Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex. I want to speak to a human.
Before I transfer you, can I help you with this myself?
No thanks, I'd really rather speak to a person, so please just put me through.
I am connecting you with a colleague now. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
